name: Nicodemus
overview: Nicodemus, a Pharisee and ruler of the Jews, approaches Jesus at night acknowledging Him as a teacher from God due to the miracles He performs. In their conversation, Jesus reveals the necessity of being born again—born of water and the Spirit—to enter the kingdom of God, highlighting the spiritual transformation required beyond physical birth. Nicodemus’s questions reflect the challenge of understanding this new birth, emphasizing the distinction between flesh and spirit in the process of salvation.
